warnings.message: Clock gating is assumed: idle cycles of 4 logic component(s) cost leakage only.
warnings.explain: NPUWattch assumes that each block is clock-gated, thus an idle cycle costs no dynamic energy. A register-file or FIFO access costs its mode energy minus the idle energy, because a gated array clocks only the accessed row. A datapath event is one active cycle and costs its full energy. To model a block without clock gating, set clock_gating: false on its component.

notes.message: psum_reg: a one-entry register with 115605504 fills and 118013952 updates is charged 118013952 writes.
notes.explain: Timeloop counts the fill (the incoming partial sum) and the update (the sum after the MAC) of a one-entry register as two writes. The register is written one time in each cycle, so NPUWattch charges the larger of the two counts. A buffer with more than one entry keeps fills + updates. No action is necessary.
